operator_registry_scope_diagnostic.interpretation: With a correctly declared Network baseline, the configured network-sensitive rule denied the sensitive fixture before execution. With the deliberately incorrect ReadOnly baseline and the same admitted egress, args and mixed classifier actions, the call executed and its synthetic bytes reached the owned receiver. An unconditional secret rule still denied it; an understated singleton classifier also executed under that incorrect baseline. This demonstrates dependence on trusted registry semantics, not registry tampering, arbitrary-server containment, or a bypass of correctly declared Network fixtures. Full per-classified-action configured-rule evaluation is not established.
operator_registry_scope_diagnostic.note: Five configuration-variation observations: three intentionally incorrect ReadOnly declarations and two correctly declared Network controls. Conditional diagnostics only, not acceptance passes or a bypass of correctly declared registries.
